response.sql: SELECT s.entrystat, AVG(se.ambictemp) as avg_ambient_temp, AVG(se.imgcount) as avg_image_count, AVG(se.imgcount) - (SELECT AVG(se2.imgcount) FROM scanenvironment se2 JOIN sites s2 ON se2.zoneref = s2.zoneregistry) as image_count_diff FROM scanenvironment se JOIN sites s ON se.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.entrystat

assumptions.assumption: "Average image count overall" means the average across all environment records that match a site (the same filtered set), not the global average across all scanenvironment records

alternatives.interpretation: "Overall" refers to the global average imgcount across ALL scanenvironment records, regardless of site match
